projection_limits: Only selected public combat actors, current scalars, active keywords, hero health/armor and the explicitly compared settlement checkpoints are reconstructed.
Other board actors, objectives, aura/equipment provenance, mana/hand/deck/play history and transient tag-write publication order are not recreated.
Native card definitions are retained; a fixture setup spell supplies observed scalar/keyword material. It does not claim the native producers of that material were replayed.
Absent client numeric tags use listed zero conventions. Those assumptions and the older build prevent certification of the fixed CN target.
The two empty TLC_817t/TLC_817t2 trigger blocks inside the last window remain in source evidence, without manufacturing their absent side effects.

cases.comparison: Both positive combat damage deliveries precede both graveyard moves; observed pair damage and ordered graveyard identities only. Aura provenance and later cleanup are not reconstructed.

Positive damage to defender, shield consumed on attacker, no positive retaliation damage to attacker, defender dies and attacker survives without rebirth. No claim that client tag-write order equals engine health-event publication order.

Two actual Windfury attacks, first through Taunt; second kills native Spirit. Its overheal damages the observed opposing hero before the new 3/1 Spirit is present with Reborn spent. Internal seed reproduces this observed branch, not the official RNG/seed.
